2: To the chief Musician. Of the sons of Korah. On Alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, a help in distresses, very readily found.
3: Therefore will we not fear though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the heart of the seas;
4: Though the waters thereof roar [and] foam, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
5: There is a river the streams whereof make glad the city ofGod, the sanctuary of the habitations of the Most High.
6: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved:God shall help her at the dawn of the morning.
7: The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved; he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
8: Jehovah of hosts is with us; theGod of Jacob is our high fortress. Selah.
9: Come, behold the works of Jehovah, what desolations he hath made in the earth:
10: He hath made wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariots in the fire.
11: Be still, and know that I amGod: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.
12: Jehovah of hosts is with us; theGod of Jacob is our high fortress. Selah.
